text: There is a deep pothole in the middle of the road near the main bus stop in Ward 12. Two bike riders slipped and fell here yesterday evening. Please repair it before someone is seriously injured.
tests: Injury and safety wording should raise severity to high.

text: The garbage bin at the corner of Lane 4 has not been emptied for three days. Waste is spilling onto the road and the smell is unbearable. Flies and stray animals are gathering around it.
tests: Mentions stray animals but the main issue is uncollected garbage, so the category should stay Garbage.

text: The streetlight outside the community hall has been off for over a week. The lane is completely dark at night and women and children are afraid to walk here after sunset.
tests: Safety concern without an injury. Adjust severity if the team's rubric treats night-safety as high.

text: A main water pipe has burst near the petrol pump and water has been gushing onto the road since early morning. The road is flooded and thousands of litres are being wasted. Please send a repair team urgently.
tests: Large, ongoing water loss plus the word 'urgently' should give high severity.

text: The manhole cover near the primary school gate is missing and the hole is wide open. Children walk past it every day. Someone should cover it immediately.
tests: Short complaint with a serious hazard. Children and an open hole should drive high severity.

text: A pack of about eight stray dogs keeps chasing children and cyclists near the playground. A child was bitten on the leg yesterday. We need the dogs to be taken away and vaccinated.
tests: An actual bite incident should be high severity.

text: A large branch from the neem tree fell across the lane last night and is blocking the road. Cars cannot pass, but luckily no one was hurt. Please remove the branch.
tests: Road is blocked but nobody is injured, so medium rather than high.

text: Some of the paving tiles on the footpath outside the public library are slightly uneven. It is not urgent, but it would be good to get them levelled when the staff have time.
tests: Polite, explicitly non-urgent wording should give low severity.

text: The road near the bus stop is in terrible condition. There is a big hole that has been there for weeks and bikes keep skidding on it. Somebody will get hurt soon.
tests: Duplicate of extra-01 in different words. Should land in the same duplicate group.

text: Nobody has cleared the rubbish from the Lane 4 corner since Monday. It is overflowing and stinking. Please send the collection truck.
tests: Duplicate of extra-02 in different words. Should land in the same duplicate group.
